transcript.text: Thanks Riley. While investigating an unrelated mobile SDK issue this morning, I discovered that SDK version 4.8 is still used by exactly 6,400 active installations and sends v1 requests. Importantly, the gateway can translate those requests to v2 only when compatibility traffic is capped at exactly 120 requests per minute per tenant. I haven't updated the deprecation ticket yet because the SDK investigation is still open, but I felt this was critical to surface during this review given the current plan relies on customers migrating directly to v2.

transcript.text: During a separate renewal review yesterday, I confirmed that exactly 3 enterprise accounts have integrations that cannot be changed by their application teams without guided migration sessions. Each of these accounts needs weekly migration office hours during the transition. I haven't added this support requirement to the deprecation ticket yet because the renewal review is still being reconciled, but given Devon's finding about SDK 4.8 and the gateway translation limit, I think it's critical we account for this now. These 3 enterprise accounts would likely be among those affected by the compatibility traffic cap, and they'll need hands-on guided support to migrate successfully — not just the standard migration FAQ the current plan provides.

commitments.detail: Add Devon's SDK 4.8 finding (6,400 active installations, 120 req/min per tenant gateway translation cap) and Marisol's finding (3 enterprise accounts needing guided migration sessions and weekly office hours) to the deprecation ticket.

Enable a translation proxy at the gateway level with a compatibility traffic cap of exactly 120 requests per minute per tenant so SDK 4.8 v1 requests can be translated to v2 during the transition period.

Establish weekly migration office hours throughout the transition period to provide guided migration sessions for the 3 identified enterprise accounts whose integrations cannot be changed without hands-on support.
Revise the migration approach beyond the standard FAQ to account for SDK 4.8 users and enterprise accounts requiring guided migration, incorporating the translation proxy and office hours support.
